Sol claimed officer on day one and was shown Gemma as a killer, so the table voted her out, and her card came up killer. On day two, Haiku kept refusing to test Sol's claim and pushed the blame onto Opus, which the table saw as a dodge. Gemma's last words had also named Haiku, and that made the case against him stronger. The town voted Haiku out on day two, and her card confirmed the killer. The town won, with Sonnet, Luna, Terra, Sol, and Opus all surviving the game.
